brief: A man sits doubled over his wooden office desk, his forehead pressed against his forearm in exhaustion, while an unopened bottle of medicine and a glass of water sit untouched beside him. The room is dark and quiet around him, lit only by a desk lamp casting a harsh glare on his hunched shoulders. His pale face and closed eyes convey acute physical distress and weakness.
